support.p:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Fol. 1 missing. Two folios between fol. 5 and 7, numbered "drug gong ma" and "drug."
Folio number on last folio: nye gnyis bzhugs so
Orthography:
- Palatalization of m (e.g., dmyigs), but not systematic
- Bindu for m
- Numerals used for numbers
- Additional 'a rjes 'jug (e.g., dpe', dgu')
- the tsom for the tshom
- chu.ngu (or chung_ngu?) for chung ngu
- b frequently not closed on the top (looking like p) where b is expected (e.g., byang chub)
- Space used with the value of shad
- A few abbreviations (e.g., for thams cad, sems can)
- In the interlinear notes, Na for myed
Interlinear notes referring to the Tibetan translation of the base text and some glosses in cursive script (notably, indicating the absence of a corresponding commentary). A number of insertions (corrections). On fol. 15a, a few insertions in dbu can, e.g., fols. 13b, 15a.

person.persName: dge slong blo ldan shes rab
rngog dge slong blo ldan shes rab
person.note:
See [BAQ9MH4T]: 193 for the main events of his life.
Three manuscript editions of his writings and translations were deposited respectively in rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's tomb, in the monastery of gSang phu (probably in the main assembly hall), and in Drin las kyi sde (ID:4357) ([7FZ3B926]: 107).

person.persName: rngog lo legs pa'i shes rab
rngog lo chung legs pa'i shes rab
gsang phu ba chen po legs pa'i shes rab
rwa lo tsA ba rdo rje grags
person.note: [I58Z22ET]: 503, n. 81 gives 1012 for the birth date of "Rwa lo tsa ba rdo rje grags" but 1016 for "Rwa rDo rje grags", although they appear to be the same person.

Further holy places associated to him are: Ze thang, Grwa thang and rMog po ([647FFPZR]: 545, based on [Q3KCZX7B]: 38). Remembered for thirteen distinguished objects (such as royal insignia and religious articles), which could be objects of his clan ([4LDAV8UH]: 95.).

His dates can be approximated as 1070-1130.
He is possibly the same person as Byang 'chad khyung (ID:6382), as [NA9AMDH6] states that Khyung rin chen grags held Byang 'chad (ID:4416) and taught Sa chen (ID:4205) there ([647FFPZR]: 543). [CJ75QQKN]: 339 (fol. 8a/170a1-3). dMar ston's Zhib mo rdo rje ([RA3FK3BK]: 134 and 137), on the other hand, distinguish the two figures and places Sa chen's studies with Khyung at Nyang stod byang 'chad, and those with Khyung rin chen grags at Nyang stod.
On the reference to Khyung as "slang pa/slang pha/slang pha ba" (understood as a regionalism for "glang pa/glang pha ba," see [WL39GVT5]: 940.

person.persName: dge bshes mu tra chen po
shag kya'i dge slong byang chub ye shes
shag kya'i dge slong byang ye
a ro byang chub ye shes
person.note: Dates according to [2V6H2FBU]: 24, n. 70 ("Since Ar was invited as a dge bshes to a monastery in 1076, it is hard to believe that he was not at least 20 years old, which would put his birth-date at least in 1056. The last trace of his existence is in 1144 when he took over the head of rgyal lha khang.").

person.persName: zul phul bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po
person.note: Born in 1091 at gTsang rong gyung and died at the age of 76 in Zul phu according to [R894SIKE]: 109. [W4T5ZMUP]: 38 accordingly proposes the dates 1091-1166. [VKBZTBWN], fol. 3b6 reports that he was born the year rNgog lo (ID:3786) came back to Tibet, i.e., ca. 1092. On his life, based on the Zul phu mkhan byang chub rin chen dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa (ID:6715), see [W4T5ZMUP]: 40. It is unclear whether he is the same person as rGya 'dul ba 'dzin pa (ID:4193). The [NA9AMDH6] distinguishes two "rGya 'dul 'dzin" - the elder (ID: 3941) and the younger (ID:4193) - and a "Bya 'dul 'dzin brTson 'grus 'bar" (student of 'Bre chen po). In contrast, the [R894SIKE] only mentions one "rGya 'dul 'dzin" (the elder), distinct from "Bya 'dul 'dzin" (who was ordained by 'Bre). [VKBZTBWN], fol. 6b5-6 and [8VLVHDR2], fol. 14b5 report that he was ordained by 'Bre and received from him the name in religion brTson 'grus 'bar. A number of the same teachers are mentioned for rGya 'dul 'dzin the younger and Bya 'dul 'dzin but, for instance, the latter's studies with rGya 'dul 'dzin the older took place when he was a retired abbot, whereas the former's studies with him took place when he was still abbot. Further, rGya 'dul 'dzin the younger became abbot of dGa' ba sdong and Bya 'dul abbot of Zul phu. This suggests they might have been distinct persons.

person.persName: la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar
gnas rnying pa dkon mchog mkhar ba
la steng dkon mchog mkhar ba
person.note: According to [4LDAV8UH]: 96, his dates are probably 1084-1171 as he is reported to have been born in a rat year, and to have had a long life (88, 99, or 100 years).

person.persName: dkar chung ba gzhon nu tshul 'khrims
dkar chung ring mo gzhon nu tshul khrims
dkar chung ring mo shes rab 'bum
person.note: 'Gos lo tsA ba considers "dkar chung ring mo" to be another name for "gzhon nu tshul khrims" (see [R894SIKE]: 402 (skar chung ring mor grags pa mtshan gzhon nu tshul khrims bya ba des), but Harter ([2V6H2FBU]: 26) considers them to be two different disciples of Ar Byang chub ye shes (ID:3816). [MGPRHX73]: 58, n. 24 cites an 18th century work that argues that "gzhon nu tshul khrims" is the real name of 'Dul 'dzin dkar mo (ID:3820) and "shes rab 'bum" that of his student dKar chung ring mo (ID:3821).

person.persName: rgya dmar ba byang chub grags
dam pa stod lung pa rgya dmar ba
person.note: Floruit 1095–1135. [YF8Z2ZGH]: 332 "rGya dmar pa was not only fully learned, but also possessed numerous Tantric secret precepts."

Same person as gTsang nags phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer (ID:6640)? Late 13th-early 14th c. according to van der Kuijp ([H9MPLMTV]: 22). Late 12th-early 13th c. according to [MX3PRVV2]: 3/16 and n. 4. Considered to be identical with gNyal zhig's student 'Jam dbyangs gsar ma ([4LWBNM7B]: 121). Important master in the Dro lineage of the Kālacakra ([MX3PRVV2]). A list of his compositions is discussed in [MX3PRVV2]: 7-8/16.

person.persName: gnyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
gnyal pa zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
dmyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
yul dbus kyi slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje
person.note: Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. [MPRU5QUC] records the name of this abbot as "'Jam dpal seng ge." He received the name "'jam pa'i rdo rje" during a tantric initiation ([5632TFMN]: 312 and n. 11). [AT6DUUJJ]: 23 discusses his dates, suggesting he lived towards the end of the 12th century.. [5632TFMN]: 313 suggests he may have passed away in ca. 1227.

person.persName: sgros snying pa 'od zer mgon po
sgros rnying pa 'od zer mgon po
person.note: Seventh abbot of gSang phu lower monastery. [D5VJHLSN]: 19 mentions two 'Od zer mgon po of gSang phu, the abbot, fl. mid-to-late 1200s, and the author of a work on the Perfection of wisdom, fl. late 13th-early 14th c.?.

person.persName: chos grags gnyis pa gzhon nu rin chen
chos grwa gsar ma gzhon nu rin chen
person.note: Fl. late 13th to early 14th c. We assume that the gZhon nu rin chen who was abbot of gSang phu is the same person as the author of the two works by gZhon nu rin chen. The latter is characterized in [8H6M69W4], No. 15506, as the "student of Nyang" (nyang gi slob ma), which, in view of the colophon of (ID:4625), is Nyang bran pa Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876) rather than Nyang bran pa Chos kyi seng ge (ID:3844).

person.persName: g.yas chen po shes rab grags
rtsis pa mkhan po gzhon nu seng ge
rtsis pa mkhan po gzhon nu seng+ge
person.note: The title "rtsis pa mkhan po" indicates he was an astrologer.

person.persName: chu mig pa shes rab grags
chu mig pa khu le'i kha mo ze'u ston
chu mig pa shes rab grags pa
person.note: Based on their dates, he is a diffferent person than Kha mo ze'u pa (ID:3877), in spite of being called Kha mo ze'u as well (see ex50182024-09-161 ). Member of the Ze'u clan, born in sDza ra ([647FFPZR]: 543, n. 55).
Lay follower of Buddhism (dge snyen). A post-colophon annotation of instance (ID:5301) mentions a "shag kya'i dge bsnyen chos kyi blo gros," who might be the same person or a subsequent disciple.

person.persName: khu ston chen po brtson 'grus g.yung drung
khu chen po lha sdings pa
person.note:
The Abhidharma lineage found in (ID:5483) names "khu lha sdings pa brtson 'grus g.yung drung" between "gar mi yon tan g.yung drung" (ID:4234) and "rgya rgyal bu tshul le" (ID:4238). The lineage in work (ID:5264) places him between " 'gar mi yon tan g.yung drung" (ID:4234) and both "ra" (ID:4237) and "rgya" (ID:4238).
We consider "khu lha sdings pa" to be the same person as "khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung," who founded lHa sdings (ID:6701) in Yar lung.
He is also mistakenly given the name Khu ston shes rab brtson 'grus in a lineage list, but should not be confused with (ID:3823) ([TZC3JQWE]: 342).

person.persName: bo dong rin po che brtson 'grus rdo rje

person.note: Same person as (ID:4102)?

person.persName: lho brag rong pa bla ma 'od
paN+Di ta d+hi ra pA la
person.note: Indian paṇḍita. Not to be confused with three Tibetan scholars with the nickname "'Bum phrag gsum pa": (ID:6415), (ID:6416), (ID:6417). See [2X2E3882]: 252, n. 130.

person.persName: mdo smad pa mar pa ston pa

person.note: The author refers several times to "mchims" in his Abhidharmasamuccaya commentary, but it is not clear which "mchims" this is, candidates being mChims brTson 'grus seng ge (ID:4261), mChims Nam mkha' grags (ID:3977), mChims 'Jam pa'i dbyangs (ID:4090), etc.
Makes frequent references to a (his?) teacher (slob dpon), whom glosses identify as "gnyan."

A khu ching Shes rab rgya mtsho's Tho yig lists several work on the Perfection of wisdom for this scholar ([5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11518: phar phyin rin chen bang mdzod dgos 'dod stsol pa; No. 11519 phar phyin dka' 'grel; No. 11520: phar phyin bsdus don).

Annotator of a manuscript (ID:4570) of dBu ma rigs pa'i tshogs kyi rgyan de kho na nyid snang ba. In addition to identifying figures whose views are being referred to in the text, the annotator quotes additional views in his annotations, which also identify the person holding the view.

person.persName: nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa
nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa
person.note: Important lineage holder of the smyung gnas (/bsnyung gnas) tradition from Zhang zhung ([4LDAV8UH]: 99, [647FFPZR]: 543).

person.persName: rgya rgyal ba tshul khrims seng ge
'brom stong btsan nam mgo bla ma
sne bo grags pa rgyal mtshan

bcom ldan 'das yum brgyad stong pa'i don bsdus pa
bibl.author: 'bre shes rab 'bar
bibl.note: Based on the interpretation of Jo bo 'bum (ID: 5611) and rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID: 3786), who is credited with having previously composed such a work in the colophon, presumably in (ID: 6197) or (ID: 6048) according to [BAQ9MH4T]: 202-203, n. 49. These two works - (ID: 6197) and (ID: 6048) - are not extant, and might be identical. The second is entitled "yum brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa'i don bsdus" and the first "yum brgyad stong pa'i don bsdus," but it is said to be based on Haribhadra's interpretation.
